title: Crispy Honey Chili Sausage
subtitle: English breakfast components roasted and finished on one pan.
description: Bacon, sausage, tomatoes, mushrooms, and eggs roasted on sheet pans — full English breakfast without ten pans on the stove.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Crispy Honey Chili Sausage in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Double-check seasoning after scaling — crew palates run salty after long shifts, so taste the first portion before opening the line.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Sausage. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Line two sheet pans with foil and lightly oil. Arrange sausages on one pan and bacon on the other with space between pieces for even rendering.

steps.title: Roast meats
steps.instruction: Roast sausages 15 minutes, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 160°F. Roast bacon 12–15 minutes until crisp. Hold warm tented with foil.

steps.title: Roast veg
steps.instruction: Toss tomatoes and mushrooms with oil, salt, and pepper on a clean sheet pan. Roast at 425°F until tomatoes collapse and mushrooms brown, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Warm beans and toast
steps.instruction: Simmer baked beans in a pot over low heat, stirring occasionally. Toast bread until golden. Keep beans and toast warm on the line.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Crispy Honey Chili Sausage onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Fry eggs and assemble
steps.instruction: Fry eggs in butter over medium until whites are set (165°F) and yolks are runny. Plate each serving with sausage, bacon, beans, roasted veg, toast, and a fried egg.

steps.title: Final quality check before service
steps.instruction: Walk the line once before opening service for Crispy Honey Chili Sausage — confirm hotel pans are labeled, backup trays are in the 200°F oven, and thermometers are calibrated. Rookies should ask a senior cook to spot-check the first portion.

stationWorkflow: Separate bacon and sausages on different pans so bacon fat does not steam the links.
Warm beans on the back burner while the oven handles veg—timing is everything.
Fry eggs in two skillets in parallel so ten plates finish within the same 5-minute window.
cleanupNotes: Drain bacon fat from foil into a container once cooled—never pour grease down the drain.
Discard foil liners with rendered fat to cut scrub time on sheet pans.
leftovers: Reheat roasted components on a sheet pan at 350°F; fry fresh eggs separately.
Mash leftover beans and sausage into a toast topping with cheddar for quick rarebit-style bites.
